
@@OPENMAP:config@@
# OpenMap container lab: ISC dhcpd serving the fxlab-e bridge
authoritative;
option domain-name "lab.openmap.test";
default-lease-time 600;
max-lease-time 7200;
ddns-update-style none;

subnet 10.250.70.0 netmask 255.255.255.0 {
  range 10.250.70.100 10.250.70.150;
  option routers 10.250.70.1;
  option domain-name-servers 10.250.70.53, 10.250.70.54;
  default-lease-time 600;
}

# a second scope served through a relay (declared, no leases in the lab)
subnet 10.250.71.0 netmask 255.255.255.0 {
  range 10.250.71.50 10.250.71.99;
  option routers 10.250.71.1;
  option domain-name-servers 10.250.70.53;
  default-lease-time 3600;
}
